firmware.title: X6887-16.2.0.150SP06-OP005PF001AZ-16.3.0.140SP26-OP007PF001AZ_20260821115243
firmware.description:
If the battery level is below 30%, please charge your device to at least 30% before installing the OTA update.

Update Version:
16.3.0.140SP26(OP007PF001AZ)

AI
· Improved speech recognition accuracy and long-text translation coherence, with support for more advanced semantic understanding.
· Optimized AI subtitle generation for faster speeds and more accurate syncing with live video streams, improving the cross-language viewing experience.
· Fixed issues where Folax could fail to execute some commands from the lock screen, stop replying or reading aloud after the AI model was changed, or cause Dynamic Bar to repeatedly appear or disappear unexpectedly.

AI Suggestions
· Added TikTok recommendations to Dynamic Bar, making it easier to discover trending videos in real time.
· Added intelligent Lazada parcel tracking, so you can view delivery status at a glance.
· Upgraded travel management across scenarios with support for international and cross-city travel cards that intelligently show itinerary information based on your location.

AI Search
· Supported search for MindHub content, including summaries and collections.
· Supported natural language search for Settings, making it easier to find options using everyday phrasing.

Network & Connectivity
· Added RTT calling, with real-time text input and display during calls for more efficient communication.
· Optimized intelligent flight scenario detection and network search logic to reduce battery drain during travel and extend standby time.
· Updated call recording with automatic recording for selected contacts and optimized file naming for saved recordings.
· Added Data Saver 1.0, a new system-level data management solution with home screen data cards and background network blocking to reduce unnecessary data usage.
· Fixed occasional issues where NFC door access could fail, the Wi-Fi connection screen could get stuck after a failed connection, and the Wi-Fi static IP page could be obscured by the keyboard.
· Optimized 5G/4G signal icon display stability and fixed the issue where connection status could display incorrectly after closing VPN apps.

Multi-Device Connection
· Cross-device audio sharing: Support casting phone audio to a PC or tablet from the same brand for a louder, higher-quality audio experience.
· Seamless communication sync: Phone calls and text messages can be synced in real time to a PC or tablet from the same brand, so you can respond quickly without using your phone while working or streaming media.
· Cross-device keyboard and mouse control: Support using a PC keyboard and mouse to quickly control your phone or tablet for more efficient multi-device collaboration and input.

Home Screen & Themes
· Fixed issues where, after device activation, cloud folder apps could reappear at the end of the home screen, and where lock screen clock styles could appear inconsistent before and after a global theme upgrade.
· Fixed display issues with resizable icons and improved Launcher stability after home screen restoration, making long-term use more reliable.

Notifications
· Fixed issues where email push notifications could fail to arrive, duplicate cards could appear in the notification bar during dual media playback, and notifications could be unresponsive after tapping upon multiple incorrect password attempts on the lock screen.
· Fixed touch responsiveness issues in parts of the notification bar to improve interaction responsiveness.

Settings
· Fixed issues of the eSIM management interface buttons not appearing for extended periods, and the abnormal wireless settings reconfiguration after eSIM was turned on or off.
· Fixed issues with Active Halo Lighting displaying incorrectly, restricted switching of call modes after voiceprint enrollment, and inconsistent font sizes in the AI W

firmware.title: X6887-16.3.0.140SP26-OP007PF001AZ-16.3.0.150SP09-OP006PF001AZ_20260904104901
firmware.description:
If the battery level is below 30%, please charge your device to at least 30% before installing the OTA update.

Update Version:
16.3.0.150SP09(OP006PF001AZ)

Calls
· Optimized audio stability during calls in weak network conditions to make call audio clearer and more stable.
· Fixed the issue where switching from Mobile Data to Wi-Fi could briefly interrupt connectivity in some scenarios, making network transitions smoother.

Home Screen & Control Center
· Fixed the occasional issue where badges did not appear on the home screen app icons after messages were received.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the home screen layout displayed incorrectly after a system update.
· Fixed the occasional issue where some Control Center icons were displayed incompletely after switching to High Resolution mode.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the lock screen wallpaper appeared inconsistent after a system update.

Performance
· Fixed the occasional issue where swiping up to exit AI Gallery responded slowly, making exit gestures more responsive.
· Fixed the issue where the More menu could lag when opened from the photo sharing screen in AI Gallery.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the notification shade responded slowly when swiping down, making interactions smoother.
· Fixed the occasional issue where swiping through the screenshot preview after taking a regular screenshot could stutter.
· Optimized the disappearing animation for floating notifications to reduce stutter and make transitions smoother.

More Functional Optimizations
· Fixed the occasional black screen issue in Facebook, improving the app experience.
· Optimized system resource scheduling to fix occasional crashes in some third-party apps.

Reminding:
· Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
· Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
